scope: Source-only review of the frozen producer and existing type/editor contracts before exposure to candidate implementation. No runtime invocation, source edit or candidate acceptance.

findings.subject: Exact six-node lineage
findings.detail: LegacyTree.ancestors explicitly orders parentA, gpA1, gpA2, parentB, gpB1, gpB2. Only parentA.uma and parentB.uma supply tree parent names.

findings.subject: Repeated occurrences and recorded bonuses
findings.detail: LegacyApplicator.build_legacy pushes each factor ID occurrence and adds native cap/starting bonus contributions. The display must show stored maps and occurrences without deduplicating, recalculating or assigning the current stat total to inheritance.

findings.subject: Completion is not a selected-choice record
findings.detail: LegacyState.inheritanceComplete records completion and inspirationEventsDone records a count; neither stores the chosen inheritance option index. Present completion/progress without inventing the selected choice or its effects.

findings.subject: Do not transform recorded lineage through an editor helper
findings.detail: LegacyPanel.flattenLegacyFactors and native LegacyTree.flatten_factors clamp/default stars for effective input. A record viewer should display the supplied node factorId/stars literally and distinguish missing values.

findings.subject: Absent, empty and flat-only records
findings.detail: RunMeta.legacyTree is optional and skipped when absent. Native factor resolution uses nonempty structured sparks, otherwise the flat list; parent-name resolution is independent. An empty/name-only tree must not falsely imply the flat entries had a structured ancestry.

findings.subject: Optional snapshot mirror fields
findings.detail: The current TypeScript snapshot mirrors omit legacyTree, compatibilityScore, blueStartBonuses, pinkStarTotals and inspirationEventsDone. Optional mirrors permit honest old-snapshot absence while retaining current serialized facts.

conclusion: No blocking mismatch in the frozen nine-group contract. Preserve the two implementation constraints and the empty/name-only versus flat fallback distinction. This review qualifies source assumptions only.
